## Native UI polish — macOS and iOS
- Refined session-preview icons while preserving alignment and compacting animation timing. - Long model names truncate from the beginning, preserving the useful suffix. Device names and thinking levels remain readable. - Session and Chat scroll indicators stay visible throughout scrolling, then hold for 1.2 seconds before fading. - Tighter, balanced spacing above and below the resting composer: 12pt on Mac, 6pt on iOS excluding the system safe area. - Voice transcription and multiline input expand as native Liquid Glass overlays without pushing chat bubbles upward. Existing composer controls and bottom placement are preserved. - Approval prompts now share the question card’s typography and capsule-button style (upstream #400).
Includes native regression coverage for glyphs, metadata, indicators, composer geometry, history reading, voice behavior and chat follow-tail. Style batch: [#399](https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/399).
### Updating
- Existing Mac users: **Kraki → Check for Updates…** - New Mac installations: download **Kraki.dmg** and drag Kraki to Applications. - Companion iOS build: **0.1.20**, delivered through TestFlight after Apple processing.
Mac **0.2.65 (67)** — signed, universal (Apple Silicon + Intel) and notarized. Built-in Tentacle remains version-locked to the release commit.

## Mac 0.2.64 (66)
### Voice input reliability — #397 - Capture lifecycle and audio transport no longer depend on the UI queue. - Detect missing microphone data, input changes, invalid conversion and stalled uploads instead of silently waiting. - Keep audio and finish messages ordered, bound queued audio, and fence callbacks from older recordings. - Preserve received text as an incomplete draft on failure. Distinguish an ASR ending without a final from normal correction still in progress. - Add release-safe diagnostic metadata without recording audio, transcripts, provider messages or credentials.
The same client fix ships on iOS 0.1.19. The companion voice gateway 0.3.6 is deployed with compatible terminal handling and authorization-race fixes: https://github.com/corelli18512/coinfra/pull/26.
### Quiet reconnect and catch-up — #396 - Cached conversations stay visible while reconnecting; connection/catch-up status stays in the title rather than interrupting the composer. - Retry missed catch-up requests and keep a running card behind the message it belongs to. - Voice input pressed while disconnected shows Connecting and starts after reconnection; cancellation never starts a hidden recording.
### Distribution Universal arm64/x86_64, Developer ID signed and notarized. Built-in Tentacle remains 0.35.10. Mac auto-update, ZIP, tar and DMG assets are available below.
These changes fix verified code defects; they do not establish the trigger of the originally reported timeout.
**Full changelog:** https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/compare/mac-v0.2.63...mac-v0.2.64

## What's Changed * fix(apple): notification test-host guard compiles in Release by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/390 * Windows fixes from a clean Windows 11 VM E2E (Tentacle 0.35.9, Mac 0.2.62) by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/391 * Proxy support: sign-in and relay connection through HTTPS_PROXY or the macOS system proxy (Tentacle 0.35.10, head 0.19.4, Mac 0.2.63) by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/392
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/compare/v0.35.8...mac-v0.2.63
